newsitem.title: UK: Aerodata seeks action on shr swap deal.
newsitem.headline: Aerodata seeks action on shr swap deal.

text.p: Australia's Aerodata Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday it had served a writ to engineering services company Scott Pickford seeking enforcement of an share exchange agreement made between the two firms on December 13, 1996.
Scott Pickford said on January 10 that it was not in a position to take a decision on Aerodata's possible offer or on the bid by rival Core Laboratories at 53 pence a share.

According to the deal on December 13, 1996, Aerodata would buy 2.5 million of Scott Pickford's 10 pence shares at 48 pence each which would have given it a 20 percent stake in the current share capital of the British Company.
Scott Pickford was to be offered 1.873 million shares in Aerodata at A$ 0.50 each amounting to 4.3 percent of the current issued share capital.
Both companies had an informal arrangement by which they have shared some of their inputs regarding remote sensing methods.
Accordingly, Aerodata said it held or had irrevocable undertakings in 21.5 percent of Scott Pickford as of January 8.
However, a day later Scott Pickford received a bid offer at 53 pence a share, valuing it at 6.7 million stg, from U.S.-based Core Laboratories NV.
Aerodata later said it was also in talks for a possible offer at 53 pence per share.
Scott Pickford has not responded on either of the offers so far.
